id./param/scenario/cs/b_040_cs_140.pack|cs_: "Papi... I'm home.
"Who are you...?
"You're... my son, Norberto!! How dare you show your face!!
"Eeek! S-Sorry!!
"Sorry? ...Norberto. Are you mistaken about something?
"Did your chivalry make the whole world smile?
"...No. Not yet.
"Then... why did you come back!!
"You made big claims and left. And you shamelessly return without fulfilling your dream! I didn't raise you like that!
"Ugh...
"P-Papi...
"...Damn. If I weren't in this state, I'd have punched you.
"Thank you, Papi! You've always acknowledged me!
"I did come back with my dream unfinished, but there's a reason.
"...Mordegon.
"Yes. In a world with Mordegon, people can't smile from the heart.
"...So I'll beat Mordegon. Then I'll bring back a bright world and fulfill my dream!
"Ha! Beat Mordegon? You've said something huge again! Interesting! Try it!
"I will! A knight never goes back on his word!
"...And, I have a favor to ask, Papi.
"Until I beat Mordegon, please look after my companions and lead them in my place.
"Ha! Easy! Helping those in trouble is chivalry!
"Really, Papi!?
"Of course! I'll take it on! A knight never goes back on his word!
"Eee, Papi, thank you!
"...Everyone! Say hello to Papi!
"Eee! What a lovely room! Gorgeous!
"Wow, Sylvando's papi! So cool! Please take care of us!
"H-Hey! Norberto! What is the meaning of this!?
"Yes, Papi. Wear this."
"...Whoa! W-What are you doing!!
"What's this outfit! I never agreed to this!!
"But you said you'd lead everyone in my place.
"...A knight never goes back on his word, right?"
